description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/advection_1d_inflow_ppm.esm (model AdvectionPPMInflow, test mms_steady_inflow_ppm) at the problem's default resolution (N=64) through each binding's official simulation pathway. Exercises the open-boundary PPM inflow/outflow first-derivative rule ppm_D_inflow_bc (one-sided PPM reconstruction with the inflow ghost gL at the left wall and non-reflecting zeroth-order extrapolation at the right wall). Pins the PPM lowering (ic wiring at t=0) and bounds the steady-drift transport error at t=0.1. The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

python._doc: Deterministic LSODA/RK45-vs-Tsit5 integrator-method disagreement on a floor-sensitive time-integrated functional: mms_steady_inflow_ppm[2] rel 2.13e-06 / abs 8.23e-10 (ref 3.868006e-04). MEASURED from CI run 33272496703 (2026-08-29); the values are bit-stable across runs and the inline assertions pass at the problem-file tolerances, so only the cross-binding re-evaluation band is widened (10x headroom, decade-rounded). Re-tighten if the bindings ever pin the same integrator.
